cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: See What This Took
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize the courage, restraint, or emotional labor your choices required.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've brought the angry draft of my apology. You may appreciate how much of it I didn't send.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I appreciated the apology. Why bring this?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because saying sorry took ten minutes. Keeping the rest from you took all night, and that effort deserves recognition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now I want to read what you kept from me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Reading isn't approved. You may admire the thickness with it closed. I'd like you to recognize my restraint without making me exercise it all over breakfast.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 grants appreciation of withheld anger, A3 demands recognition of the all-night effort and A5 denies reading while permitting closed admiration, using access authority to seek credit for restraint.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 why-bring question causes A3 effort distinction; B4 curiosity threatens withholding, causing A5 a limited inspection that preserves it.

relationship.evidence: B2 already values the apology and B4 is naturally curious about a displayed angry draft, so A creates the very pressure now controlled.

heightening.evidence: B4 wish to read would undo the restraint, causing A5 to request recognition that does not require another exercise of it.

specificity.evidence: A1 unsent draft and A3 ten-minutes/all-night distinction establish the work; A5 closed thickness is physically straightforward after correction.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 admire without making me do it again earns the restraint paradox from B4 curiosity.
